Questions
Who is Hypefury for? People building a personal brand or a creator business: coaches, consultants, founders, writers, educators. If your audience is part of how you make money, Hypefury is built for you.
Which platforms does Hypefury post to? Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads, LinkedIn (personal profiles and company pages), TikTok and Bluesky.
Does the AI need lots of past posts? No. Hypefury reads the posts you have, even a handful, and pre-fills your voice: your field, audience, topics, tones and goals. No posts yet? Fill in that short form yourself. You can change it anytime.
What happens when the trial ends? Nothing is charged: the trial needs no card. Your account, queue and settings stay. Scheduled posts stop going out and the AI stops writing until you pick a plan on the billing page.
Is it safe to connect Instagram? Yes. You log in on Instagram's own page, through Meta's official Instagram API. Hypefury never sees your password: Instagram grants it a permission you can remove anytime by disconnecting the account.

Questions
How does the free trial work? You get 7 days with everything in Creator, plus a preview of social listening (1 keyword, 3 drafted replies). Pick a plan before it ends to keep your account active.
What counts as a platform? Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, TikTok and Bluesky are 1 platform each. On Flexible, each one is $6/month. On Creator and Pro, all 6 are included.
Can I connect 2 accounts on the same platform? Yes, each workspace connects 1 account per platform. For a second Instagram account, create a second workspace. Creator comes with 2 workspaces, Pro with 5.
Can my team use it? Yes, on the Pro subscription, you can invite up to 2 managers to your workspaces. They can write, schedule and publish posts, but can't see your billing or delete a workspace.
Can I switch plans later? Yes. Move between Flexible, Creator and Pro, or between monthly and yearly billing, all from the billing page.
Can I cancel anytime? Yes. Cancel from the billing page in a few clicks.
Will I be charged by surprise? No. You don't need a credit card to start a free trial, so nothing is charged when your trial ends unless you pick a plan. You can cancel from the app anytime, no email needed.
Do you charge per post or per DM? No. Scheduling and Instagram auto DMs have no per-use fees on any plan.
Are prices in US dollars? Yes. Prices are in US dollars and exclude VAT. Tax is added at checkout based on your billing address.

pages.text:
Skip to content Features Pricing Blog Log in Start your 7-day free trial Menu
About Hypefury Built for speed.
Aimed at payday.
A falcon doesn't flap around. It spots the target and goes. That's how we build Hypefury: so you make better content, faster, and get paid for it.
How it started Hypefury started in 2019 as a weekend project. Its founder wanted a tool that didn't exist, so he built it, and a lot of creators wanted it too. Since then we've learned that posting was never the hard part. Making something good, making it fast and making it pay is. So that's what we build now.
Where we're going Spot it. Dive. Get paid.
Everything on our roadmap shortens the trip from "I have an idea" to "someone just paid me".

House rules 01 Your voice, only louder
We help you make it faster and better, but it's still your story. No generic, and definitely no bland.
02 Built with you, not at you
Our roadmap is mostly your inbox. You're talking to the people who ship the fix, not a help-desk maze.
03 Open in good times and bad
When something breaks, we say so early and keep you posted until it's fixed. No spin.
04 No fluff
If a feature doesn't save you time or make you money, it doesn't ship. That includes this page.
